name: sjdigitals.co
title: SJ Digitals Co. — Agency & Platform Infrastructure
description: Flagship digital systems platform and corporate web presence for my technology agency, SJ Digitals Co. Features zero layout shifts, bespoke client portals, NFC smart business card routing, and instant edge caching.

specs.stack: Semantic HTML5, Modular CSS3 Tokens, Vanilla ES6+

case_study.context: Small and medium enterprises often struggle with bloated, slow website templates with massive JavaScript payloads and painful layout shifts.
case_study.problem: Create a high-impact, luxury digital agency web presence with zero build dependencies, near-perfect Lighthouse scores, and instant worldwide loading.
case_study.engineering: Engineered with modern vanilla web standards, custom CSS property tokens, responsive clamp() typography, and edge CDN cache headers.
case_study.architecture: Client Browser ➔ Edge Anycast CDN ➔ Brotli-compressed static assets ➔ Dynamic WhatsApp lead routing API.
case_study.result: 99+ Lighthouse performance index, sub-100ms first contentful paint, and seamless lead conversion for digital branding clients.

name: indian-central-school
title: Indian Central School — Institutional Academic Portal
description: Enterprise institutional web portal and academic management infrastructure for Indian Central School (Gaya, Bihar). Engineered for high availability, student admission workflows, and fast mobile responsiveness.

specs.stack: Semantic HTML5, CSS3 Grid, Vanilla ES6+, Edge CDN

case_study.context: A prominent regional educational institution required an authoritative digital portal for admissions, faculty announcements, and parent communication.
case_study.problem: Construct a responsive, tamper-resilient web portal capable of handling peak admissions traffic with zero layout shifts and instant asset caching on low-bandwidth mobile networks.
case_study.engineering: Designed modular HTML5 architectures, optimized SVG branding assets, and integrated secure inquiry and admission routing workflows with zero third-party framework overhead.
case_study.architecture: Student/Parent Device ➔ Edge CDN Caching ➔ Static Delivery Engine ➔ Secure Inquiry Webhook & Direct School Desk Routing.
case_study.result: Reliable 100% uptime during admissions season, sub-second load times on rural cellular networks, and modernized institutional presence.

name: chandrawati-enterprises
title: Chandrawati Enterprises — Workforce Outsourcing Portal
description: Production web platform for a major manpower and industrial workforce outsourcing corporation in Gaya, Bihar. Engineered for high performance, local asset bundling, and interactive quote dispatch.

specs.stack: Semantic HTML5, CSS3 Grid/Flexbox, Vanilla JS, Vercel Edge

case_study.context: A local corporate workforce supplier required a modern digital presence to service enterprise clients, verify candidate profiles, and generate contracts.
case_study.problem: Deliver a fast, accessible portal with zero third-party framework lock-in, ensuring instant loading even over cellular 4G/3G networks.
case_study.engineering: Designed responsive design systems, modular CSS architecture, and direct client WhatsApp API quotation hooks without bloated npm dependencies.
case_study.architecture: Static Asset CDN ➔ Local Caching Service Worker ➔ Client Inquiries Engine ➔ Direct Business WhatsApp Dispatch.
case_study.result: Instant first contentful paint, 100% responsive compatibility across low-end smartphones, and significant inbound corporate client leads.

name: linux-continuity
title: Linux Continuity — Android ↔ Linux Continuity Bridge
description: Apple-style Continuity ecosystem bridging Linux desktop workstations with Android devices. Real-time clipboard synchronization, AirDrop-like zero-friction file transfer, shared media controls, and interactive shell execution over secure local sockets.

specs.stack: Python 3, ADB Protocol, Linux Desktop Notifications, Cryptography

case_study.context: Linux users often lack the seamless device integration that macOS and iOS users enjoy (AirDrop, Universal Clipboard, device controls).
case_study.problem: Build an open-source, local-first bridge between Linux and Android without requiring third-party cloud servers or invasive proprietary services.
case_study.engineering: Implemented an asynchronous daemon architecture using local sockets, ADB port-forwarding, system notification hooks, and secure peer discovery.
case_study.architecture: Android Client ↔ Encrypted Local Transport / ADB Forwarding ↔ Linux Desktop Daemon ↔ Desktop D-Bus / Clipboard Service.
case_study.result: Sub-millisecond clipboard transfer, instant file dispatch, and complete independence from cloud services.

name: pinion
title: Pinion — Universal Wireless Print Engine for Android
description: Universal wireless print server and hardware spooling daemon for Android. Bridges CUPS, IPP, AirPrint, and Mopria printing protocols with a modern embedded Web UI and root-level automation.

specs.architecture: Native Android Service & Embedded HTTP Core
specs.stack: Java 8+, Android NDK, CUPS Daemon, IPP Protocol, Raw Sockets

case_study.context: Modern enterprise and legacy USB printers cannot be easily addressed from mobile devices without expensive network print server appliances.
case_study.problem: Transform any cheap Android device into an industrial-grade, multi-protocol network print server supporting iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows clients.
case_study.engineering: Integrated a lightweight native Java HTTP/IPP engine with direct raw printer spooling over USB OTG and WiFi, managing print queues and status telemetry.
case_study.architecture: Client (AirPrint/IPP) ➔ Android WiFi Interface ➔ Pinion IPP Listener ➔ Spooling Buffer ➔ USB OTG Printer Device (/dev/usb/lp0).
case_study.result: Zero-configuration wireless printing across iOS, Android, and Linux with full real-time job monitoring.

name: Zezes
title: Zezes — Android USB OTG ISO Deployment Core
description: Emergency bare-metal multi-boot installer core running directly on Android. Emulates hardware CD-ROM / USB mass storage devices over USB-C OTG using Linux Kernel USB Gadget ConfigFS.

specs.architecture: Kernel USB Gadget Subsystem & ConfigFS Driver
specs.stack: Kotlin, C / Shell, Linux USB Gadget API, Mass Storage LUNs

case_study.context: When a PC motherboard or operating system crashes, creating a bootable USB installer typically requires access to another working computer.
case_study.problem: Enable an Android phone to emulate a physical bootable USB drive via USB OTG so that PC BIOS/UEFI discovers it as a genuine installation media.
case_study.engineering: Programmed Android Linux kernel USB Gadget via ConfigFS, configuring virtual Logical Unit Numbers (LUNs) to serve raw ISO blocks directly over hardware endpoints.
case_study.architecture: ISO Image on Storage ➔ Kernel ConfigFS Mass Storage Function (f_mass_storage) ➔ USB PHY Controller ➔ PC Motherboard BIOS/UEFI.
case_study.result: Successfully boots Windows, Ubuntu, Arch Linux, and diagnostic live distributions directly from phone storage.

name: nitrosense-linux
title: NitroSense Linux — Acer EC Thermal & Fan Governor
description: Native Linux fan speed controller and thermal monitor for Acer Nitro series gaming laptops. Directly queries and modifies ACPI Embedded Controller (EC) registers to override proprietary firmware fan limitations.

specs.architecture: Direct ACPI EC Register Read/Write Driver
specs.stack: C, Python 3, PyQt6, Linux ec_sys Kernel Module
specs.platform: Linux Kernel 5.x / 6.x on Acer Nitro 5 Hardware

case_study.context: Acer Nitro laptops under Linux run fans on conservative default firmware curves, leading to thermal throttling during compute-heavy tasks with no official OEM software.
case_study.problem: Reverse-engineer the proprietary Windows NitroSense driver and build an open-source native Linux equivalent that directly commands the laptop's Embedded Controller.
case_study.engineering: Mapped ACPI EC memory registers using ec_sys, identifying fan control offsets, automatic/manual control flags, and RPM sensors to build a reactive thermal governor.
case_study.architecture: Hardware Thermal Sensors ➔ Linux ec_sys Driver ➔ NitroSense ACPI Register Engine (0x00-0xFF) ➔ Reactive Fan Speed Daemon.
case_study.result: Drops sustained gaming/compilation temperatures by 10-15°C with customizable speed curves and zero proprietary Windows bloat.

name: Dodo-RF
title: Dodo-RF — Sub-GHz Wireless Protocol Analyzer
description: Ultra-portable hardware RF analysis, signal capture, and packet synthesis platform built for CC1101 transceivers paired with ESP32 and RP2040 microcontrollers across 315, 433, 868, and 915 MHz bands.

specs.stack: C++, Arduino / ESP-IDF, SPI Hardware Bus, Python Desktop GUI
specs.platform: ESP32 / RP2040 Microcontrollers + TI CC1101 Transceiver

case_study.context: Sub-GHz RF analysis tools (such as software-defined radios or dedicated analyzers) are either prohibitively expensive or too bulky for field work.
case_study.problem: Engineer a handheld, low-cost Sub-GHz radio analyzer capable of sniffing, decoding, recording, and transmitting digital radio signals with microsecond timing accuracy.
case_study.engineering: Designed firmware controlling TI CC1101 registers via high-speed SPI, implementing packet filtering, demodulation presets (ASK/OOK, 2-FSK), and pulse-width timing capture.
case_study.architecture: RF Antenna ➔ TI CC1101 Transceiver ➔ High-Speed SPI Bus ➔ ESP32 Microcontroller Core ➔ Real-time Signal Analyzer.
case_study.result: Reliably decodes remote key fobs, automated weather stations, industrial gate controllers, and security sensors in real time.

name: databricks_pipelines
title: Databricks Medallion Data Lakehouse Architecture
description: Industrial distributed data lakehouse pipelines implementing Bronze, Silver, and Gold Medallion architecture on Apache Spark / PySpark and Databricks Delta Lake with ACID transactional guarantees.

specs.stack: PySpark, Databricks Delta Lake, Apache Spark, Python

case_study.context: Enterprise data systems frequently suffer from corrupted schemas, unreliable batch ETL jobs, and un-reproducible analytical downstream reporting.
case_study.problem: Construct a resilient, automated data engineering pipeline that ingests raw telemetry, validates schema integrity, and delivers curated aggregated data marts.
case_study.engineering: Built layered PySpark pipelines utilizing Delta Lake ACID transactions, enforcing schema validation at ingestion (Bronze), deduplication and enrichment (Silver), and business aggregation (Gold).
case_study.architecture: Raw Source Streams ➔ Bronze (Raw Ingestion) ➔ Delta ACID ➔ Silver (Cleaned & Enriched) ➔ Gold (Aggregated Analytics).
case_study.result: Zero data corruption, reproducible schema enforcement, and optimized Z-order queries on millions of records.
